'''Denfa''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[third Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He and his [[Unidentified Nautolan Padawan (Denfa)|Padawan]] were assigned to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during [[Mission to Onderon (3627 BBY)|the conflict there]] and were killed by an Imperial.<ref name="Onslaught" />
